_howto: Elections polled by the Louisiana Secretary of State adapter (server/src/adapters/lasos.js). data = the JSON blob endpoint the voterportal.sos.la.gov/graphical page reads. electionId = ElectionMode.htm PKElectionID for this election (nothing is stored while the site is in another election; ElectionDates.htm lists them). date = the election date (the yyyyMMdd blob folder). Parish files are swept sweepBatch per poll. Set enabled:false to stop polling.
